def fill_rule(g, mincnt=3, fillc=2):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    colcnt=[sum(1 for r in range(h) if g[r][c]!=bg) for c in range(w)]
    rowcnt=[sum(1 for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg) for r in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=bg: continue
            # vertical bounded run
            up=next((rr for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1) if g[rr][c]!=bg), None)
            dn=next((rr for rr in range(r+1,h) if g[rr][c]!=bg), None)
            lf=next((cc for cc in range(c-1,-1,-1) if g[r][cc]!=bg), None)
            rt=next((cc for cc in range(c+1,w) if g[r][cc]!=bg), None)
            if (up is not None and dn is not None and colcnt[c]>=mincnt) or \
               (lf is not None and rt is not None and rowcnt[r]>=mincnt):
                out[r][c]=fillc
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    i,o=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    f=fill_rule(i)
    print(k, f==o)
    if f!=o:
        for r in range(len(i)):
            for c in range(len(i[0])):
                if f[r][c]!=o[r][c]: print(' mismatch',r,c,i[r][c],o[r][c],f[r][c])

print(json.dumps(fill_rule(G['Test input'])))

def bbox(g):
    bg=CounterInit=None
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),bg

def border_fill(g, fillc=2):
    r0,r1,c0,c1,bg=bbox(g)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if (r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1)) and g[r][c]==bg:
                out[r][c]=fillc
    return out
